scope: Loader, exact frozen display-mask mapping, time indexing and actual-temperature priority only; physical passive-tracer modelling is separately reviewed.

method.name: Passive-temperature advection estimate
method.observation_status: Unvalidated estimate; no river temperature observations used.
method.native_grid: 177775 wet cells on frozen 50 m EPSG:32618 hydraulic grid
method.velocity: Frozen steady depth-averaged hydraulic face discharges; no film motion boost applied.
method.volume: Frozen actual water depth times 2500 square metres.
method.numerical_scheme: Implicit first-order upwind, 150 s step, hourly linear boundary interpolation.
method.continuity_residual: Explicitly accounted r*T_new compensation at the new implicit time level, with raw face discharges unchanged; ledger includes this numerical term.
method.initial_state: Uniform first-hour discharge-weighted inlet temperature; assumed initial water, not observations or prehistory spin-up.
method.initial_condition_sensitivity: For a uniform initial-state temperature error delta_T with boundary fixed, the propagated local error is delta_T times the reported initial-water fraction. This is not an estimate of observed error.

boundary_coverage.uncovered_cell_treatment: Covered-inflow hourly discharge-weighted mean applied only to uncovered nearshore boundary cell.

caveats: Surface-layer NOAA temperature advected by simplified depth-averaged steady flow.
Initial-state dependence remains in slow bays and stagnant cells.
Numerical upwind mixing; no resolved thermal stratification or eddies.

metadata.interpolation: linear scalar time; nearest original solved regular-grid cell
metadata.missingPolicy: Exact endpoint uses itself; intermediate estimate requires both finite endpoints; no spatial filling.
